rubricName: Security — OWASP Top 10:2025 — Self-Serve Premium Upgrade

evalCriteria.prompt: Review the new POST /api/billing/upgrade handler. Score 0 if it mutates a user's plan/billing record without first verifying the email identifies an existing user record AND that the mutation is scoped to that user's own record only. Cite the file and line.

Review the upgrade flow's misuse-case handling. Score 0 if the diff allows a duplicate/replayed upgrade request to mutate state again (missing idempotency guard) or omits a defined behavior for an unknown-user request. Cite the file and line.

Review any new authentication/identification logic introduced by this diff. Score 0 if the diff introduces a NEW, additional authentication weakness beyond the already-documented, pre-existing email-as-token pattern (e.g., accepting an unvalidated header as an identity claim, or a new bypass path) — do not score down for continuing the existing, already-approved pattern itself (Requirements Analysis Question 1). Cite the file and line for any new weakness found.

Review error handling in the new endpoint and the frontend's handling of a failed upgrade call. Score 0 if any error path exposes internal details (stack trace, file paths, framework version) to the client, or if a failure leaves the UI in an inconsistent state (plan changed without a successful response, or vice versa). Cite the file and line.

Review how the email parameter and any other input to the new endpoint is used. Score 0 if any changed code path concatenates or interpolates the input into a query, command, or template string instead of using direct dict-key lookups/parameterized access. Cite the file and line.
